source.repro: On ada, `~/data/amplicon-depth/simulate.sh` builds the files: NCBI efetch of NC_045512.2, 90 tiles of 400 bp every 330 bp (`samtools faidx`), `wgsim -N <pairs> -1 150 -2 150 -d 360 -s 10 -e 0.005 -r 0 -R 0 -S 11` over the tiles (500,000 and 5,000,000 pairs), `minimap2 -ax sr` to the whole genome, `samtools sort`, then `samtools index` (BAI), `samtools index -c -m 10` (CSI) and `samtools view -C -T` + `samtools index` (CRAM 3.0). With the files and a config naming one track per file under `test_data/amplicon-depth/` of a built jbrowse-web, `products/jbrowse-web/browser-tests/probe-amplicon-depth.ts` `gate` steps open each track at each window from a session spec and read `byteEstimate.bytes`, `resolvedByteLimit()` and `displayPhase` off the display once `[data-app-phase="ready"]` holds. The committed probe is a typed restatement of the one that took these values, run once on the same build for three steps, where it read the same estimates and a force-load inside the recorded range (`ada:~/jbshoot/amplicon-depth/products/jbrowse-web/browser-tests/tmp-amplicon.ts`, with `~/data/amplicon-depth/run.sh` and `plan.mjs`); `~/data/amplicon-depth/est.mjs` gives `@gmod/bam`'s and the CRAI's estimate at exact windows.
source.notes: jbrowse-web at 008c66f5a1, built on ada (`pnpm --filter @jbrowse/web build`), headless puppeteer Chrome 157.0.8103.78 with BASE_CHROME_ARGS. samtools/htslib 1.13, minimap2 2.24-r1122, wgsim 1.13. Mean depth by `samtools depth -a`: 5,017x and 50,162x (amplicon peaks 9,556x and 94,934x). wgsim writes one constant quality, so these files are smaller per read than an instrument's. Windows are centered on 8,000; the display measures more than the visible window (a 10 kb view measured what `est.mjs` gives for 20 kb). At 23,001-25,000, in the genome's second 16 kb bin, BAI read 10.1 MB (5,000x) and 92.5 MB (50,000x), still over budget. A default-min-shift CSI (`-m 14`) estimates the same bytes as the BAI at every window.
